sections.title: Decision Under Review
sections.purpose: States the approval question the reader must answer and the scope of the proposed review, so the reader knows what a yes or no commits them to. Establishes the problem the review is meant to address and the consequence of leaving it unaddressed.

sections.title: Proposed Mechanism and Path
sections.purpose: Describes how the proposal operates: the sequence of steps, the path it follows, and the boundary of what it changes versus leaves intact. Written as third-person exposition so the reader can evaluate the mechanism independently of any advocacy for it.

sections.title: Decisive Evidence per Claim
sections.purpose: Maps each load-bearing claim about the mechanism to the specific passage that supports it, and marks claims that rest on assertion rather than demonstration. Gives the reviewer the basis for approving on evidence rather than on plausibility.

sections.title: Qualifications and Conditions
sections.purpose: Names the conditions under which the proposal's reasoning weakens, including unverified assumptions and cases outside the described path. Frames what a conditional approval would need to specify.
